issues.message: NTFF box extends into CPML region along z-axis. Far-field results will be corrupted. Shrink NTFF box to interior.

this simulation requests NTFF far-field output but registers no point probe. run() and forward() score their ring-down settling witness from the recorded probe time series, so the result will carry settling_db=None and those DFT numbers will have no truncation guard (#885); add sim.add_probe(position, component) somewhere the field is live and retain its time series. Inspect forward's diagnostic on the concrete result after JIT/AD evaluation.
